description: Use this when the user has approved a draft_incident_post draft's exact text and recipients. Posts it as the dashboard's Incidents tab does: it shows on the status pages and FlareWarden emails the subscribers, members and webhooks the draft named. Returns the incident. Safe to repeat: the same draft id posts once and returns the first result. Not for changing the text: make a new draft.

confirm.description: The plan's confirm sentence, exactly as returned; show it to the user first.

draft_id.description: The draft's id from draft_incident_post (it starts with pl_).

name: publish_incident_post
title: Publish a drafted incident post
